concerns.text: Task T004 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but writes to a single mutable log file `data/logs/interactions.jsonl`. Parallel execution could cause race conditions or interleaved writes, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee.

Task T005 is tagged `[P]` yet produces validation records that are written to a shared file (`data/results/semantic_validation.jsonl`). Concurrent runs may corrupt the JSON‑Lines output, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T007 aggregates per‑task validation records into a single file `data/results/semantic_validation_by_session.jsonl`. Marked `[P]`, but aggregation writes to a common output, which is not safe for parallel execution.

Task T008 performs statistical analysis and writes `outputs/analysis_results.jsonl`. The `[P]` tag is inappropriate because the analysis reads the aggregated file from T007 and writes a single result file, which cannot be safely run in parallel with other instances.
Task T009 generates the final markdown report `outputs/report.md`. Being `[P]` is unsafe since it depends on the unique output of T008 and writes to a single report file.
Task T010 runs contract‑validation tests over all JSON‑Lines artifacts. The `[P]` tag is unsafe because the test suite reads shared files that may be concurrently modified by other `[P]` tasks.
